issues.jp_before: 授業[じゅぎょう]{が|ga-subject}九時[くじ]{に|ni-time}始[はじ]まります。
issues.problem: Generic schedule statement: は is the more natural choice, so が is not the single best answer.
issues.action: Rewrote as もうすぐ授業が始まります (Class is about to start), where reporting the imminent event makes が the clear choice.

issues.jp_before: 会議[かいぎ]{が|ga-subject}午後[ごご]三時[さんじ]{に|ni-time}終[お]わりました。
issues.problem: With a known meeting and the time as the new information, 会議は is at least as natural; two answers possible.
issues.action: Rewrote as やっと会議が終わりました (The meeting has finally ended).

issues.jp_before: コピー機[き]{が|ga-subject}故障[こしょう]しています。
issues.problem: lv 2 too high; 故障 is N3.

issues.jp_before: 社長[しゃちょう]{が|ga-subject}明日[あした]大阪[おおさか]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]きます。
issues.problem: Plain statement about the president's plans: 社長は is the default, so が is not the single best answer.
issues.action: Rewrote as a question with 誰が (Who is going to Osaka tomorrow?), where が is required.

issues.jp_before: 新[あたら]しい社員[しゃいん]{が|ga-subject}四月[しがつ]{に|ni-time}入[はい]ります。
issues.problem: Generic statement; は equally natural for the same English.
issues.action: Rewrote as 四月に新しい社員が三人入ります. The number after the subject makes が the natural choice.

issues.jp_before: 山田[やまだ]さん{が|ga-subject}大学[だいがく]{を|o-departure}卒業[そつぎょう]しました。
issues.problem: は equally natural; also a near-duplicate of the 山田さんが会社を辞めました item.
issues.action: Rewrote as an embedded clause, 木村さんが大学を卒業したことを聞きました, where は is impossible. Swapped the distractor の (marginally possible as ga/no conversion) for で.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{が|ga-subject}教室[きょうしつ]{から|kara-from}出[で]ていきました。
issues.problem: 教室を出ていきました is equally natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added を as an alternative: {から/を|kara-from}.

issues.jp_before: 午後[ごご]二時[にじ]{から|kara-from}会議室[かいぎしつ]{で|de-place}会議[かいぎ]{が|ga-subject}始[はじ]まります。
issues.problem: 二時に始まります is equally natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added に as an alternative: {から/に|kara-from}.

issues.jp_before: 会社[かいしゃ]{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{に|ni-location}タクシー{が|ga-subject}止[と]まりました。
issues.problem: 前で止まりました is also natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added で as an alternative: {に/で|ni-location}.

issues.jp_before: 月曜日[げつようび]{に|ni-time}、新[あたら]しい部長[ぶちょう]{が|ga-subject}着[つ]きました。
issues.problem: 着く (arrive after travelling) is unnatural for a new boss taking up a post.
issues.action: Rewrote as 新しい部長がやっと決まりました (The new department head has finally been decided).

issues.jp_before: 運動場[うんどうじょう]{で|de-place}生徒[せいと]{が|ga-subject}走[はし]っています。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 廊下を学生が走っています.
issues.action: Rewrote as 運動場で生徒がサッカーをしています.
